flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No court application batch code in the six repos. Only data/UI groundwork that does not perform the exclusion: ocmsadminui Meta/System.ts (Court Batch Limit/Duration parameters), model Icourtcase.d.ts (csd_batch_no), NoticeSearch useSearch.getNoticesByCourtBatchNo (never called), Notice History.tsx Court Application History tab (commented out), ocmsadminapi OcmsCourtCase (only notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason).
note: The story asks that a rejected notice (processing stage already reverted and batch number already cleared, see OCMS22.15) is excluded from the batch so it is not sent for court application. No code creates, stores or reads a court application batch on the API/cron side: the OcmsCourtCase entity in ocmsadminapi only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:17-31), with no batch column. In the UI there is only the csd_batch_no data type (Icourtcase.d.ts:22-28) and a per-batch search function that nothing calls (useSearch.ts:144-150, only exported at :181). No relevant maintenance ticket. The 'Fully paid' status in the sheet is not supported by code for this story. Cannot verify from repo: the feature may live in another system/repo outside the six repos.
recommendation: Do not claim as completed based on this repo. Ask URA/the team in which repo or system the court application batch is built; if nowhere, mark it as a gap.

steps.step: Notice is rejected by the OIC, processing stage is reverted and batch number cleared (result of OCMS22.15)
steps.detail: No code: grep for court application / court batch / courtBatch / csd_batch / CourtApplication / process-cpc in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi and thirdpartyapi finds no controller, service or UI page to select or review a court application batch. The OcmsCourtCase entity only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason, so there is no batch number column to clear. The csd_batch_no type exists only in the UI model.

steps.step: OCMS excludes the rejected notice from the court application batch
steps.detail: No code: grep for court application / court batch / courtBatch / csd_batch / CourtApplication / process-cpc in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi and thirdpartyapi finds no controller, service or UI page to select or review a court application batch. No logic removes/marks a notice in a batch; there is no batch entity and no endpoint.

steps.step: The notice is not in the batch list sent for court application
steps.detail: The only batch reader in the UI is getNoticesByCourtBatchNo (useSearch.ts:144-150), which no component calls, and the Court Application History tab is commented out (History.tsx:170-172). There is no send-to-court process to check.
